svg.title: File modification legend
svg.desc: A visual taxonomy of file categories, file operations and named change allowances. Stage examples connect category icons to allowed edits and future checks. Initial file boundaries and future parser validation are design targets, not installed enforcement.
svg.text: Which files? What edits? What proves the edit is allowed?
Guard workflow • Design-review legend • No enforcement is installed by this diagram
Only the stage’s allowed files and operations are opened.
Production → src/**/*.cs Test → tests/** + analyzer tests Rule → analyzer implementations
Config and docs use project mappings. Workflow artifacts use their registered paths.
Location examples, not grants. Shared or mixed-purpose file assignments remain to be defined.
EDIT ≠ DELETE ≠ MOVE. Permission for one operation does not grant the others.
One edit can have several kinds. Icons identify changes—not permission, approval or successful validation.
Read a stage allowance left to right
Examples describe the boundary; they do not authorize a particular function or exception.
Entry throw: add one statement, preserve the existing body
Illustrative exception. The allowance selects the actual exception and target function.
Instructions / review: intended change inside the file
Compare the actual edit with its named allowance.
Declarations / signatures • Bodies / expressions • Imports / dependencies / settings
Recognizing an assertion edit ≠ proving a stronger test.
All files outside the grant stay locked—including prior inputs and other agents’ outputs.
Edit permission is separate from Must pass / May fail. Project patterns and stage operation grants are still to be settled.
